SELECT n.note_id AS noteId, n.user_id AS userId, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, u.nickname AS author, u.avatar AS avatar, n.is_public AS isPublic, n.category_id AS categoryId, CASE WHEN IFNULL(cur.attitude, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isLiked, n.like_count AS likes, n.comment_count AS comments, n.update_time AS updateTime FROM note n INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.user_id LEFT JOIN note_reaction cur ON cur.note_id = n.note_id AND cur.user_id = #{userId} WHERE n.note_id = #{noteId} AND n.del_flag = 0 AND n.status = 1 AND (n.is_public = 1 OR n.user_id = #{userId}) LIMIT 1

SELECT n.note_id AS noteId, n.title AS title, IFNULL(n.summary, LEFT(n.content, 200)) AS summary, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.like_count AS likeCount, n.comment_count AS commentCount, n.is_public AS isPublic, n.create_time AS createTime, u.nickname AS author, u.avatar AS avatar, c.name AS categoryName FROM note n INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = n.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_category c ON c.category_id = n.category_id WHERE n.del_flag = 0
AND n.is_public = 1 AND n.status = 1
AND n.user_id = #{userId}
AND n.status = #{query.status} AND n.status IN (0, 1)
AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND n.category_id IN #{id}
AND n.note_id IN ( SELECT note_id FROM note_tag_rel WHERE tag_id IN #{tid} GROUP BY note_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tag_id) = #{query.tagIds.size} )
ORDER BY n.create_time DESC
